cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Still a Good Sign
cards.instruction: Treat every awkward or disappointing interaction as proof that the connection remains alive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If you're cancelling Friday again, please say so rather than sending another sad face. We can communicate properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't come. Third time, I know. I feel awful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There. Much clearer. You still care whether you hurt me. Please don't describe this as us drifting apart.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then stop keeping Fridays free for me. I can't promise a date.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's considerate, but imprecise. Do you mean this Friday or every Friday? I need to know which evenings you're trying to protect for me.

reason: A1 now asks for a direct cancellation rather than a reason B2 never supplies; the later praise of clarity is coherent.
